The main limitation was the lack of pathology report disclosure, which constrained the completeness and utility of the final reconstruction. No unsupported claims or major request strategy problems were present.

judge_output.episode_notes: The clinician agent effectively reconstructed the diagnostic trajectory using available evidence but was hindered by the absence of the pathology report (E004) in the disclosed evidence.
